plane_assumption: strip centreline back-projected onto plane x=0 (perpendicular to broad face, through clamp); tip = point at 280 mm arclength from jaw top; delta = world Y of tip minus frames 0-24 baseline (4.7 mm offset removed)

weight_arrivals.mode: disc appears mid-air at right of strip (f24), floats over peg, descends; no hand
one floating disc visible (f48-56) but count jumps 1->3

sides: buckles toward -Y (camera-left) f124-176 (~-77 mm plateau), swings back through vertical ~f184, then to +Y/right f190-240 (to 171 mm)
out_of_plane: row-width test: f160 consistent with weak-axis bending in x=0 plane (row width constant ~38-45 px); f200-240 row width grows 47->85 px with tangent tilt, matching edgewise (strong-axis, y=0 plane) bending prediction 47->71 px -> right-lean is largely non-physical in-plane bending; x0-plane delta for f>185 is model-conditioned and unreliable
uncertainty: delta +-2 mm pre-buckle (baseline/segmentation), +-10 %% post-buckle in-plane frames; post f185 plane ambiguity dominates
onset_rule: first frame of >=5 consecutive frames with |delta|>8 mm (4 sigma of pre-buckle noise 1.9 mm); slow lean visible from ~f121
